content: Engineering software liability positioning conventions: (1) 'decision support, not a substitute for judgment of a licensed Professional Engineer' clauses (hlcengineering exhibit generator language); (2) 'software is not a copy of and does not replace any standard; official standards remain controlling' (STATIX structural software); (3) NIST-style exclusion of use where failure could cause injury/property damage; (4) disclaimer must be consistent with EULA/Terms (contradictions create risk, Usercentrics 2024). For NDT: acceptance decisions must be framed as draft recommendations requiring Level 2/3 sign-off.
